cases: same 200 development SW bases; no filtering by output
familiar: original source action placed on sibling by SW
unfamiliar: action from another development tree, absent from original options; nearest isolated token length; deterministic hash tie breaking; proxy only
neutral: nonclinical letter code; exact full prompt token count matched to familiar per model
controls: reversed branch display order retaining branch IDs
closed_book: one prefill per case, normalized probability across all single-token option letters; tertiles of original-action probability fixed within model, no case selection
primary_gap: blind accuracy minus visible accuracy; model macro mean
stop: standard neutral mean gap >= 3pp -> stop familiarity-specific sequence and revise visibility narrative; also report each model and neutral vs familiar contrasts
significance: exploratory guideline/tree clustered paired bootstrap, 5000 samples; four clusters only
